entries.en: No one followed me, no one's watchin' you. Guaranteed.

entries.en: A drop in the bucket for the higher-ups. But for me... It'll change my life.

entries.en: What about security?

entries.en: If the truck stops in one place for longer than thirty seconds, it sends out an automated signal.

entries.en: It'll alert the nearest Zetatech response team. Could expect two to three armored vehicles.
entries.ro: O să alerteze echipa de intervenție Zetatech cea mai apropiată. Te poți aștepta la două-trei blindate.

entries.en: So work fast.

entries.en: Yep.

entries.en: Place called Kenmore Cafe. Out front.
entries.ro: Kenmore Cafe, așa se cheamă. Chiar în față.

entries.en: I'll call once you're there.

entries.en: What's that gotta do with robbin' a truck?

entries.en: If I'm gonna get out of this body, I need the money.

entries.en: Mhm. A full body conversion. I've been talking to a ripper out in Abakan, Siberia. Dr. Federov.

entries.en: Said he could do it... And for a lot cheaper than in Night City or Tokyo.

entries.en: ALS? What's that? Doesn't sound so good.

entries.en: Three months ago, I was still walkin'... Three months from now, I'll trade my chair for a bed.

entries.en: I figure I got nothin' to lose. Why not take a chance? Right?

entries.en: How're you even gonna get to the USSR?

entries.en: Don't seem the rebellious type. Why do this?

entries.en: OK, count me in. Be in touch soon.

entries.en: Thanks.

entries.en: Sorry, be right with you.

entries.en: What's all this?

entries.en: Hm? Oh, uh, right. I wanted to make sure you weren't followed. I think we're OK.
entries.ro: Hm? A, ăă, da. Voiam să mă asigur că nu te-a urmărit nimeni. Cred că suntem OK.

entries.en: Care to tell me why I'm waiting?

entries.en: Ah, sorry. I didn't introduce myself. I'm Pedro.
entries.ro: Ah, scuze, am uitat să mă prezint. Pedro sunt.

entries.en: And you wanna pull a Zetatech transport heist.

entries.en: No one followed me. I guarantee it.
entries.ro: Nu m-a urmărit nimeni. Pun mâna-n foc.

entries.en: Our target is an automated Zetatech transport hauling AV thrusters.
entries.ro: Ținta e un transport Zetatech automat, care cară propulsoare pentru AV-uri.

entries.en: Its route changes daily via a randomizer.
entries.ro: Ruta lui se schimbă zilnic printr-un randomizer.

entries.en: So how do we track it?

entries.en: I refactored the randomizer. I know how it'll work.
entries.ro: Am refactorizat randomizerul. Știu cum o să meargă.

entries.en: Sure. So you can predict it's path. Then what?

entries.en: I'll stop the truck first, then breach its system.
entries.ro: Mai întâi opresc camionul, apoi sparg sistemul.

entries.en: Where do I come in?

entries.en: Well, yeah. How else?
entries.ro: Păi, da. Cum altfel?

entries.en: No... I-it's not, I'm sure.
entries.ro: Nu... n-nu e, sunt sigur.

entries.en: Listen, I just need those thrusters. Please... I need your help.

entries.en: So I go first by boat to Vladivostok, then to Abakan by train.

entries.en: I'm prepared.

entries.ro_m: E un act de război împotriva unei megacorporații. Ești pregătit să suporți consecințele?

entries.en: Hm...

entries.en: I know...

entries.en_m: If I'm gonna help you, I need to know I can trust you.

entries.ro_m: Dacă o să te ajut, trebuie să știu că pot avea încredere în tine.
